text:
ops-ana: heads-up — eu-west1 nvme qdepth and small-write storm causing GPU attach delays. seeing a pattern of janitor-triggered scrubs overlapping with nightly ephemeral cleanup. allocs stuck in pending for ~90s.
infra-bot: [ALERT] region=eu-west1 metric=nvme_qdepth pct_change=+240% window=4m
samir: paste iostat for a sample host? want to know if it's single-drive hotspot or pool-wide.
ops-ana: sample from gnode-4727:
```
Device            r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s  await  svctm  %util
nvme0n1          1.2   98.4    24.8  3124.5  2.95   1.08  96.3
```
lots of 4k/8k writes. completions piling; nvme-cli shows queue full.
lee: also seeing net txq drops on the same hosts — tcp retrans earlier at 10:58. could be qdisc backpressure coupled with i/o queueing.
marta: we widened janitor concurrency to 10 last week to clear backlog faster; maybe that created a conflict when ephemeral deletes coincided.
oncall: suggest pausing janitor on a 6-node canary in the hot stripe and demoting scrub priority. will anyone be able to route new GPU attaches away?
ops-ana: canary list: gnode-472{5,7,9}, gnode-473{0,2}. plan: pause janitor there and lower concurrency globally for eu-west. rollback = re-enable and/or revert concurrency flag.
devops-bot: pausing janitor increases scrub backlog; ensure we have a follow-up task to re-run scrubs during low-traffic window. See INFRA-7399.
ryan: cost impact: if we reroute new GPU attaches to us-west for 20m there will be egress + warm pool cost. estimate ~ $120 for 20m at current attach rates. open ticket INFRA-7399-cost.
samir: quick check: is overlayfs metadata flush also contributing? saw high fsync counts on one host.
ops-ana: yes some fsync spikes correlate. might be concurrency between janitor delete path and host cleanup.
lee: action: oncall pause janitor on canary now; also disable aggressive concurrency flag in config and ship a rollbackable change.
oncall: paused on the 6 nodes at 11:03 UTC. attaching new GPU requests are temporarily routed to us-west for 18m.
infra-bot: [ACTION] incident_id=INF-3402 assignees=[ops-ana,oncall] status=triage
ops-ana: 11:07 update — canary nodes qdepth reduced from ~98% -> ~62%, pending-allocs 58 -> 12. net retrans dropped.
marta: i'm cutting a tiny config PR to add a per-region throttle: scrub_concurrency = min(4, current_pool_shards). also adding a metric to alert when scrub + ephemeral_delete overlap > 3 minutes.
ryan: good — once PR is in, let's re-run janitor with --staggered to avoid immediate re-thrashing. we'll keep cross-region routing for 10 more minutes as buffer.
ops-ana: 11:14 final update: holding for now, will re-enable janitor with new flags after PR merge. closing incident if stable for 25m. :thumbsup:
